players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer AI Advances AI Cloud Build-Out in Malaysia and (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Bitdeer AI contracted approximately 50% of its 9.5MW A102 facility in Malaysia ahead of energization under a 5-year long term offtake commitment with total expected revenue of approximately $400 million, with a customer of high credit quality (not named); the contract is not expected to have a revenue impact in 2026, with revenue and associated costs expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027 when services commence. A102 is a liquid-cooled, multi-customer facility purpose-built for rack-scale NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 deployments, delivering both GPU cloud services and data hosting from a single site. Bitdeer AI seeks to structure its AI cloud contracts so that customer prepayments are expected to cover more than 50% of the associated capital expenditure. CFO Michael Potter: active pipeline for AI cloud capacity now exceeds $2 billion, or approximately 24.5MW; Bitdeer AI expects the pipeline to increase in the next several quarters. VP of AI Cloud Retainna Lin: Bitdeer AI entered a competitive process later than other providers and delivered ahead of them.
quarterly_data.figure: ~50% of 9.5MW A102 contracted; ~$400 million over 5 years; pipeline >$2 billion (~24.5MW)
